upload.title: Upload a sales export
upload.lead: Export the journal items (invoice lines) from Odoo as CSV (best for large months) or Excel. New lines are added; lines already stored are kept and updated if they changed. Nothing is deleted.
upload.readFailed: That file could not be read. Choose an .xlsx or .csv journal-item export from Odoo.
upload.missingRequired: This file is missing required columns: {cols}. Export it again from Odoo with the same columns as before.
upload.missingOptional: Missing columns: {cols}. Those fields will be stored empty.
upload.doneDetail: {inserted} new lines added, {updated} updated, {unchanged} already up to date. The database now holds {total} invoice lines.

err.not_configured: Uploads are not set up on the server yet.
err.no_rows: The file has no sales lines to save.
err.too_many_rows: The file is too large. Split it into smaller exports.
err.db_error: The database could not save the upload. Nothing was changed; try again.
err.bad_request: The upload could not be read by the server. Try again.
err.network: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
err.unknown_upload: The upload session was not found. Start the upload again.

upload.csvHint: CSV handles hundreds of thousands of lines per file
upload.csvStream: The file will be read and sent in batches of up to 5,000 lines.
upload.bigExcel: This Excel file is large and may be slow to read. Exporting the same data as CSV is much faster.
upload.ignoredHint: Zero-value lines without a product (tax and receivable lines Odoo adds to each invoice) are not sales and are not stored.
upload.partialKept: The {n} lines sent before the problem are saved. Upload the same file again to continue; lines already saved will count as unchanged.
upload.resumeHint: Upload the same file again to continue; lines already saved will count as unchanged.

state.error: The data could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
state.noDatabase: No database is connected, so there is nothing to show. Set DATABASE_URL to the PostgreSQL database.
state.emptyBody: Upload a journal-item export from Odoo to fill the dashboard.

rebuild.title: Rebuild totals
rebuild.lead: Use this after lines were edited or deleted directly in the database. It recalculates every dashboard total from the stored lines; the lines themselves are not changed. Uses the upload password above.
rebuild.running: Rebuilding… this can take a minute for millions of lines
rebuild.done: Totals rebuilt from {lines} lines over {days} days in {s} s.
